statement: GTEx JAK1/JAK3 results remain Tier 3 tissue-specific comparator context.
No JAK1 or JAK3 GTEx lead-eQTL MR result survived all-test FDR<0.05 or Bonferroni correction across 177 completed Wald-ratio tests.
Each exposure uses one FDR-significant GTEx eGene lead variant per tissue; estimates are single-variant Wald ratios, not multi-instrument MR.
Outcome extraction used direct SNP matches without proxy substitution; failed extractions reflect missing direct SNPs rather than null associations.
GTEx follow-up shows that JAK1/JAK3 are biologically instrumentable in selected tissues and provides lower-tier comparator signals that require replication or colocalization.
JAK1/JAK3 have been compared at the same evidence level as the multi-instrument, colocalized TYK2-RA result.
